test_policy.notes: The international undergraduate FAQ requires only a 2.0 GPA, English proficiency and secondary-school records; SAT, ACT or ACCUPLACER scores are encouraged. Students admitted without scores take the ACCUPLACER on arrival before registering. (Domestic applicants must submit ACT/SAT under an Arkansas state requirement, per the CDS.)

requirements.notes: Apply in the ATU international application portal. The $50 application fee must be paid before the in-office credential evaluation of foreign secondary records. First-time students submit mark sheets/certificates showing 12 years of schooling (unofficial uploads are accepted for admission). Evidence of funding of $29,950 for 9 months (plus $3,000 per dependent) is needed before an I-20 is issued. Minimum entering GPA 2.0; the CDS shows an almost-open admit rate (3,701 of 3,797 admitted).

deadlines.label: International application deadline for NEW visa applicants (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Dates are printed without a year; treated as fall 2027. For new visa applicants the spring deadline is Nov. 1 and summer April 1.

deadlines.label: Deadline for CURRENT visa holders already inside the U.S. (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: For current visa holders the spring deadline is Dec. 1 and summer May 10.

deadlines.label: International Excellence / IB scholarship file complete (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Complete file = international undergraduate application, scholarship application, high school transcript with GPA and two letters of recommendation, received by March 31 for fall (September 30 for spring).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants from traditionally English-speaking countries who believe the requirement should be waived must email internationaladmissions@atu.edu after applying. Transfer students from U.S. colleges may instead show College English Composition I and II with a C or better. Scores must be no more than 2 years old. A copy of an official TOEFL, IELTS or PTE report can be uploaded to the application portal.

english.notes: Valid MyBest TOEFL scores accepted. Other accepted TOEFL forms: written 500, computerized 173, TOEFL Essentials 8. The graduate minimum (79) does not apply to undergraduates.
iBT on the 1-6 scale (graduate minimum is 4.0).
Pearson Test of English. EIKEN Grade 2A is also accepted. Duolingo and Cambridge are not listed.

aid.notes: First-time international students (high school seniors with a 3.25+ cumulative GPA) can compete for the International Excellence Scholarship ($4,500 per semester for up to 8 semesters, must live on campus) or the International Baccalaureate Scholarship ($2,550 per semester); awards are competitive and may be taxable depending on the home country. Federal aid is not available to international students. ATU also lets a student who enrolls with a 2.25 GPA pay in-state tuition (about half of the out-of-state rate). CDS H6: nonresidents can receive institutional non-need-based aid; 26 did, averaging $9,723.

cost.notes: ATU international estimate for 12 credit hours per semester: tuition $12,720 ($529.98 per credit hour), fees $2,864 (include a $50 international student services fee), room and board $11,390, books $1,330, mandatory health insurance $1,646 (shown as the international extra), total $29,950. A student entering with a 2.25 GPA can get the in-state rate (roughly half the tuition), so the real cost may be lower. The CDS G1 listed in-state tuition $7,718 and out-of-state $15,436 but marked 2026-27 costs as not yet final.

sat.note: ATU's international pages give no SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: ATU's international pages give no ACT code; look it up at act.org.
